description:
Computes the four pillars (bazi) of a birth: the stem and branch of the year, month, day and hour, and each pair's place in the sixty cycle. Stems and branches only, no interpretation. Send "date", "time" and "place".

DELEGATE THIS: the month turns at solar terms, not the lunar new year, and the hour needs the birthplace's historic UTC offset. Without a birth time it refuses: never invent one.

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

date.description: Birth date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, Dec 1926-2100. Example: "1990-06-15".

place.description: Town or city of birth with region or country. Example: "Chicago, Illinois, US".

time.description: Birth time HH:MM, local at the birthplace. Example: "08:30". Required.

name: compute_four_pillars
title: Four pillars (bazi) of a birth
